Commentary.Commentary: Now then, Ireland face a stiff task! They will have to bat out of their skins if they are to chase this! South Africa, despite not having Ngidi and Rabada will back themselves to defend this. Stay tuned for the second half.

The Ireland bowling was not that bad, instead the South African batting was a little too good. They did hit the right lines and lengths but it was the class of de Kock and Malan that they were able to score freely. They though will still be pleased with the back end of the innings where they managed to restrict the run-flow. Little was the star with the ball with a two-fer but Singh was also impressive.

After winning the toss and electing to bat, de Kock and Malan started brilliantly for the visitors. De Kockw as the aggressor and Malan was happy to play second fiddle. The two added a massive 225-run stand with both scoring tons. De Kock was dismissed but Malan continued. He then had a decent stand with Rassie, at that time 360 looked possible but wickets at regular intervals at the end pushed South Africa back and they have finished below 350. Still though, a superb effort from them and they surely have a score which is above par.

End of a power-packed performance with the bat from South Africa! And we have to say, Malan was the star, he batted throughout and now walks off to a standing ovation from his team and the crowd here. A couple of Ireland players also walk up to him to congratulate him. That is how good he played.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one. SOUTH AFRICA END WITH 346!
Slower bouncer, Janneman Malan mistimes the pull and they run a single.
Short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Edge and they take a single. Temba Bavuma looks to heave it but gets an edge which goes to the short third man fielder.
Full ball and Janneman Malan drives it to the long off fielder for a single.
SIX! WOW! Full and wide, Janneman Malan smashes it over extra cover region for a huge six.
WIDE! Too wide for Janneman Malan to cut.
Full and wide, Janneman Malan drives this one to the deep extra cover fielder for a single.
Temba Bavuma tries to scoop, but without any timing, just short of the short fine leg fielder.
OUT! Cleaned him up! Yorker length ball and Andile Phehlukwayo is bamboozled by this fuller length delivery and he has to depart. He swings but it is a little too quick and it hits the stumps.
Cracking shot but straight to the deep extra cover fielder.
Full and outside off, this is jammed through covers for one.
FOUR! Edged and Four. A bit of width offered by the bowler and Andile Phehlukwayo hits it hard and gets an outside edge which races away to the boundary.
SIX! In the Arc, and out of the park! Janneman Malan smacks this half volley over the mid-wicket fielder for a massive six.
Ful length ball, Andile Phehlukwayo pushes it to the long off fielder for a single.
Yorker length ball, Andile Phehlukwayo works it to the cover fielder.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! He shuffles and takes it on the full. Pierces it through the deep extra cover region and the ball races away to the boundary.
Two! On middle, Malan swings, it goes off the inner half through square leg for a couple.
OUT! Full and wide outside off, Klaasen goes for the big one, but gets an edge and the keeper makes no mistake! A wicket very well-deserved for Little. Can they end well?.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, Malan tries to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken.
Good length ball outside off, Janneman Malan tries to slog it, but misses it.
Another run as this is stroked through covers. Just the singles in the over so far.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
Good length ball on the stumps, Heinrich Klaasen tucks it towards front of the keeper for a single.
Klaasen clips it towards square leg for a single. It was a good length ball strayed on the pads. He is off the mark.

OUT! In the air and gone. Much-needed wicket this for Ireland. Was a full ball outside off stump, Rassie looks to go over long on, but hits it straight to the long on fielder who takes an easy catch. Maybe had he tried to hit that straight, he would have got a maximum but he looked to drag it and hence, did not get the distance.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball from Young. Rassie tries to heave it to the on side, but fails to time it and takes couple of runs towards mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! And Malan reaches 150! What a knock this has been from Malan. Steps down to this length ball and smacks it straight down the ground.
A couple now! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Short ball and Malan pulled this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bumper from Adir, given as first bouncer. Well bowled by the bowler. The batsman does not look pleased.
FOUR! Finds the gap again! Shorter and on middle, Malan pulls it hard through mid-wicket, no chacen for the fielder in the deep.
FOUR! Takes it on the full and flicks it to the long on fence for a boundary. Not great fielding at the long on boundary there.
Rassie works it to the long on fielder for a single.
Rassie tries to pull it towards to mid-wicket, but gets an inside edge onto his body, No run.

FOUR! The spin does Adair in! On middle, Malan comes down the track and swings, it goes off the inner half through square leg. The ball turns past Adair who does not stop it and a boundary results. That spoils the over.
Well bowled again! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
A yorker outside off, Rassie drives but to covers.
One only! Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Gets away with one more! This is a full toss, it is pushed to mid off for one.
Gets away with it! Fuller and on off, Rassie strokes it to covers.
Another one as Rassie strokes it through covers.
A single now as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! Fortunate boundary! Malan comes down the track and also makes room. This is a full toss on the stumps, he looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge down to third man.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! In the gap! Short and on middle, Malan pulls it hard through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
Another single as this is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, Malan pushes it to covers.
On middle, it is worked through covers for one.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played! The reverse sweep is out, it is hit through point and the ball races away to the fence.
Brilliant running! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
On off, it is pushed to covers.
Twe more! Outside off, this is cut through point and two is taken.
A single as Rassie pushes it through covers.
A single now as this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! 10 from the first two balls then! A full ball outside off, it is squeezed through short third man for another boundary.
SIX! Over the fence! Malan comes down the track but once again does not get to the pitch of it. He still goes ahead with the shot and clears the long on fence with ease.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings!
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Almost! Shorter and outside off, this one turns back in. It is slightly shorter. Malan looks to cut but misses. It goes just past the off pole.
On off, Malan pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is pushed to mid-wicket.
On the pads, Rassie now works it through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, Malan works it throughy mid-wicket for one.
A dot to end! On off, it is pushed to covers.
Another single as Malan pushes it through covers now.
Rassie takes one as he strokes this through covers.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through square leg for a couple.
In the air... safe! The reverse sweep is out again. This time it is off the top edge as Singh shortens his length. It goes wide of point for two.
Just the one as this is pushed through covers.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for a single. Malan keeps strike.
Tossed up outside off, Malan guides it towards short third man. A dot.
Stays a touch low, on middle, Rassie pushes it down to long on for one.
Malan takes one now as this is stroked down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Plays the reverse sweep, plays it nice and fine on the off side for two.
Takes one now as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! The reverse sweep is out and it is played well, through point for a boundary. Nice way to get off the mark.
On the stumps, defended.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to square leg.
On middle, kept out.

OUT! TAKEN! Stop the press, Ireland have finally brokenthrough! De Kock's superb innings comes to an end! A welcome wicket and that too the one they needed, he was taking the game away. Singh bowls this shorter and on middle, a lot slower. De Kock goes back and looks to pull. He does not get all of it and it is also the longer part of the ground. Adair in the deep stands just in front of the fence at deep square leg, he is literally on his toes because he did not have enough space to keep his heel down. Takes it but then starts to lose his balance, throws it back in and takes it again. They check but the catch is clean. Can the hosts build on this now?
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: A single now, on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for one. End of a huge over for South Africa.
A single! There it is! Malan finally gets to his ton! His second in ODIs. He has played as the perfect foil to de Kock. He too will now step on the gas one believes.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Malan looks to flick but misses.
Gives the strike to the man on 99 by taking one on the leg side.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
SIX! Over the fence! de Kock gets down on one knee and then brings out the slog sweep, he drags it from wide outside off and over the long on fence.
SIX! 10 from the first two balls! De Kock has decided to cut loose! On middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Good start for South Africa after the break! Tossed up on off, this is hit down towards the long off boundary.

DRINKS! The visitors continue to dominate! THey have not lost a wicket and are cruising along. One believes once Malan gets to his ton they are probably going to go all guns blazing. Ireland need wickets if they are to stem the run-flow.
Another dot to end! On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
He remains on 99 as this is once again pushed back to the bowler. Good stuff from Ireland.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler. Malan is still on 99.
Flatter and on middle, Malan pushes it to short mid on.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Malan now moves onto 99 as he slaps it through covers for one.

100 for de Kock! What a superb knock from him! A much-needed for South Africa. They were 1-0 down in the series and needed to start well and they have surely done so. De Kock gets there by pushing it to long on for one.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! De Kock moves onto 99! Shorter and on off, de Kock hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket, it is in the gap and a boundary results.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A dot to end! On middle, kept out.
On off, it is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Crakced away! Short and on middle, this is pulled powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
A slower ball on off, it is pushed towards cover for one.
Short and this is pulled through square leg for one.
A single to end! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
FOUR! The reverse sweep is out and it is hit nicely! Dockrell bowls it very full, it is hit past short third man for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Goes for the reverse sweep but does not time it well, it goes through covers for one.
A fumble and a single to end! On off, this is pushed towards point. The fielder fumbles and a single is taken.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Going down leg! Angled into the pads, de Kock looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes towards third man for a leg bye.
On off, Malan strokes it through covers for one more.
Another one on the shorter side, this is guided down to third man for another run.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
On middle, kept out. End of another huge over for the visitors.
FOUR! McBrine is not having the best of days here. A short one, de Kock stands back and pulls it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed to mid-wicket.
SIX! As easy as you like! De Kock comes down the track and gets to the pitch of it. He lifts it over long on for a biggie. That was a big hit, McBrine did give it a little air but pays the price.
Another single as this is worked on the leg side.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A slower bumper to end, Malan ducks under it.
Really well fielded! Shorter and on middle, de Kock pulls it towards mid-wicket. Andy dives to his left and makes a half stop. Just the one.
On off, Malan pushes it through covers for one more.
FOUR! Pushed away! That is a lovely shot! Back of a length and on off, this is pushed through covers, uppishly but in the gap and a boundary results.
Around off, this is guided to the man at point.
That might have hurt! A short one on the body, Malan is beaten for pace as he tries to pull. it hits him on the body.
Little is back on!
Angles it into the pads, de Kock works it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, it is pushed through covers for one.
Comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it, he pushes it to the bowler.
Another single as de Kock eases it to long off.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, it is pushed through covers for another run.
One more single! A good over so far, can Young end it well. On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
On middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
150 up for the visitors! On off, a slower one. De Kock drops it on the off side and takes one.
Good length and on off, de Kock plays it on the off side.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Another single to end! On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Another single as de Kock works it to mid on.
Shorter and on middle, Malan pushes it down to long on for one.
Quicker and on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Malan misses out! Shorter and on the body, he pulls it but straight to short fine leg.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed to mid-wicket.
Drop and run! Another good over for the visitors! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Solid! Good length and on middle, this is pushed to mid off.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
A single this time as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is short and angling into the body, it is pulled through square leg for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Young is back on!
Now takes one by pushing it down to long off. Another good over for the visitors.
SIX! All the way! Lovely hit! Malan makes room and Sigh follows him. This is lofted over the long on fence for another biggie.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
A single now as this is pushed down to long off.
Flatter and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Malan tries the reverse sweep but it is hit towards point for one.
SIX! Over the fence. McBrine continues to go for runs. He fails to shut the over well. De Kock plays the slog sweep, he moves right across and hits it well over the square leg fence for a biggie.
On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! De Kock is well in! On middle, this is worked to the right of mid-wicket. They go for a quick run. Tectot gets to the ball and fires it to the keeper who whips the bails off. It is taken upstairs and replays show that de Kock's dive has saved him. A direct hit may have done the work.
Run out appeal and it is taken upstairs! The dive has saved de Kock!
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Malan comes down the track and the length is shorter agian. He looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Sees Malan step out a little and bowls it short, blocked.
Just the one as this is pushed down to long off for one. Singh is keeping it nice and tidy.
On off, this jis kept out nicely.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
The slog sweep is out, the slog sweep is out but it goes off the toe-end down to long on for one.
Quicker and on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Angled into the body, de Kock looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for one.
Shorter and on off, it is pushed to covers.
On middle, defended.
Yet another one as this is worked through mid-wicket.
A single now as this is pushed through covers.

SIX! Over the fence! South Africa have probably decided to step on the gas now! De Kock comes down the track and gets to the pitch of it. He lifts it over the long off fence for a biggie. Good start to the over. Andy is taking a beating here.
On middle, Malan works it to mid-wicket. A tidy over from Singh.
De Kock takes one now as he strokes it to long on again.
Takes one now as he pushes it down to long off.
Slower through the air and lands it on off, a little bit of turn, it is pushed to covers.
Quicker and on off, malan hangs back and pushes it to covers.
Fires it on the stumps, blocked.
Flatter and on midlde, defended.

FOUR! Over covers. Brings his fifty up with a glorious stroke! He has been in tremendous form from the last series and carry forwards it here. Back into the side and back amongst the runs. Comes down the track and also makes room. Lifts it over covers for a boundary.
Now takes one by pushing it down to long on for one.

SIX! Just wide! That is a brilliant effort from Singh! Malan comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He still goes ahead with the shot, the good thing is he looked to hit it straight. Singh runs to his left from long on and dives but it is out of his reach. Goes all the way. A welcome biggie as things were slowing down.
Fires it on middle, Malan flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, Malan pushes it to mid-wicket.
On middle, kept out.

Fifty for Malan! Really good innings and his good form continues but this time, he would want to cash in and build on the start he has gone. Gets there by working this with the turn through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle, Malan works it to mid-wicket.
De Kock comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He works it through mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, this is worked through square leg for one.
Slower through the air and on off, de Kock pushes it through covers for one.

DRINKS! All South Africa so far! Their openers have gone about things brilliantly and have set a foundation for a big score. They will hope the good work continues. Ireland on the other hand, need a wicket, they need this stand to be broken or they will be chasing a huge total. Can they fightback after the break?
Just short! This is on off, quicker, it holds in the surface. Malan looks to flick but is a touch early in the shot. It lands short of mid-wicket.
Driven nicely! Full and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Another single as Malan strokes it to long on for one. Dealing in singles at the moment are South Africa.
Well fielded! On middle, this is pushed to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Flatter and on middle, Malan keeps it out.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Another dot to end now! Another one on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
A dot! Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
De Kock makes room but Singh attacks the stumps, it is hit down to long on again for one.
Shorter in length and on middle, it is eased to long on for a single.
De Kock pushes this down to long on and takes one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Yet another dot! On off, Malan guides it to point.
Good length and on middle, kept out.
That is sharp and nicely played too! Good cricket all around! A sharp bumper, extra bounce. De Kock plays it well as he adjusts and guides it down to third man for one.
Another single as Malan now strokes it through the off side.
On the shorter side again and outside off, de Kock guides it down to third man for one.
Angled outside off, it is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, kept out.
Another single as Malan rocks back and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter in length and on middle, de Kock hangs back and punches it down to long on for one.
Floats it up on middle, Malan strokes it to long on for one.
Another single as de Kock now strokes it down to long off.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Singh is on now!
Another single to end the over and South Africa going along really nicely. On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Good length and on middle, plays it late and down to third man for one.
FOUR! Clipped away beautifully! Pure timing! Angled into the pads, bread and butter stuff for de Kock as he works it through mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
Outside off, this is guided to the man at point.
That has been nailed but only for one! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through square leg for one more.
Outside off, de Kock now opens the face of the bat and plays it down to third man for one more.
Drop and run! On off, de Kock plays it towards cover and gets to the other end.
A single now as this is pushed towards mid on for one.
Angled into the pads, de Kock works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
Follows the biggie with a good single as this is pushed towards cover.

SIX! Up and over and it goes over the fenc! Lovely shot. This is too full, right in the slot. This is lofted over the bowler's head and it goes all the way over the fence. A clean and a beautiful hit.
Good length and on off, Malan guides it to point.

Little needs to calm down a little now! De Kock is not happy! Angled into the pads, de Kock looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Little runs towards the ball and then tries to kick it onto the stumps but it hits de Kock. Then he takes a long turn back where his shoulder hits de Kock which the batter is not happy about. End of a tidy over from Little.
Yet another dot! On off and on a length, it is pushed to covers. A few words from Little to de Kock and de Kock does give it back.
Short but a little too straight, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
Good length and around off, de Kock guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Outside off, Malan pushes it through covers for one.
BEATEN! Length and on off, this one angles away. Malan is beaten as he tries to defend.
Powerlpay 2! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Hits the length on top of off again. Malan just pushes at it and gets the edge towards third man for a single. End of the Powerplay. A solid start by South Africa.
Pulls back the length and the ball comes in off the pitch. Well blocked off the backfoot by Malan.
Well timed straight drive again from de Kock. Cut-off by the mid-off fielder to keep it to one.
Drop and run from Malan. Plays the length delivery with soft hands to mid off and calls for the run early.
Beauty! Good length, just outside off and it holds the line. Malan tries to play at it but the ball goes past the outside edge.
de Kock nudges the length ball with soft hands towards square leg and takes a quick single.
Pitched up, outside off. Hint of swing and left alone by Malan to end the over.
Back of a length, just outside off. Pushed with good timing straight to covers.
This time it's a bit full, on off. Pushed to the cover region by Malan.
FOUR! Driven exquisitely on the up by Janneman Malan! Half volley on off, and whacked to the cover boundary.
On a good length, outside off. Malan tries to cut it too hard and misses the ball by a mile.
FOUR! SAFE! Length ball, going away from the right-hander. Malan plays at it and gets a thick edge towards third man for a boundary.
Josh Little comes into the attack.
FOUR! Beautiful use of the feet from Quinton de Kock. Comes to the pitch of the ball and lofts it high over cover without any risks for a boundary.
A tad bit fuller, outside off. de Kock plays it gently towards point.
Back of a length, on off. Punched off the backfoot to mid-off and a single is taken.
Fuller ball and pushed to mid on. Malan wanted a quick one but sent back.
A bit short to cover drive on the up. The ball goes straight to the cover fielder.
Back of a length ball, nudged with soft hands to square leg by Malan.
Nice end to the over from Young. Hitting the length hard, on top of off. de Kock misses and the ball goes to the keeper.
Blocked off the backfoot by de Kock.
Length ball, on middle. de Kock just pushes this one into the gap on the leg side for a couple.
Malan just opens the face of the bat and guides the length ball outside off towards third man for one.
Smart batting, rotating the strike after hitting the boundary. Cut away to point by de Kock.
FOUR! Class from Quinton de Kock. Full ball, outside off. Just drives it without any fuss to the cover fence.
Slower delivery, full and wide. Coming slighlty back in but left alone by Malan.
Better line and length by Adair. On top of off and Malan can only block it.
Length again and blocked away towards point this time by Malan.
2 Leg Byes! Fuller delivery, coming into the pads. Flicked off the pads to fine leg for two.
FOUR! Back of a length, outside off. Beautifully cut by Malan off the backfoot towards the point boundary.
Back of a length delivery, on off nips back in sharply and hits Malan on the thigh pad.
Very full and on off. Well timed towards the cover region by Malan and the batsmen cross for one.
Full swinging delivery, wide of the off stump. Malan tries to swing at it but gets the inside part of his bat to the cover fielder.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Defended off the backfoot by Malan.
Malan steps out and just pushes the full ball to the cover region.
Shortish ball, outside off. Left alone by Malan.
Yorker length, eased to the covers by de Kock for one.
Length ball, on top of off. Blocked solidly by Malan.
Uppish and Safe! de Kock looks to push the full ball on off stump straight but instead gets the leading edge which falls just short of the point fielder. The batsmen take a single.
Sensible batting. Blocks the tad fuller delivery on middle.
FOUR! Overpitched again and punched down the ground to the long off fence by Quinton de Kock for another boundary.
This time the ball on top of off is guided to third man for a single.
Good early call from Malan. Just tucks the length ball on the pads towards square leg and easily comes back for the second.
Good end to the over from Young. Full, on off and de Kock can only fend it away.
Full, outside off. de Kock looks to drive straight but gets it on the inside half of the bat straight to mid-off.
On middle this time and flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Hits the length hard, on off. de Kock looks to block but gets hit on the gloves.
FOUR! Pitched up this time and a perfect straight drive from de Kock. Back to back boundaries for de Kock.
FOUR! That's some timing from Quinton de Kock. On a length, outside off, just pushed towards cover and it races away to the boundary.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Just a hint of swing and left alone by Malan.
A tad short and wide. Malan cuts it straight to backward point.
Length ball, on top of off. Blocked away by Malan.
FOUR! Positive intent from Malan. Chips the ball on the pads over mid on for another boundary. He is picking up right from where he left off last time.
Peach! Pitched up, the ball straightens after pitching and Malan gets bamboozled.
FOUR! Adair starts with a short and wide one. Malan rocks back and slashes it to the deep point boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Its Mark Adair.
de Kock blocks his first delivery of the series off the backfoot. Wants a run to short cover but sent back and rightly so.
A bit fuller, inviting the drive from Malan. Gets the outside edge down to third man for the first runs of the day.
On the moeny again. Malan blocks it to cover this time.
Right on the money, on top of off. Janneman Malan watchfully blocks it away.
Length delivery, on the pads. Tucked to mid-wicket.

We are ready for play in this final ODI. The Irish team is out on the field and so are the opening batsmen for South Africa - Janneman Malan and Quinton de Kock. It will be Craig Young to bowl the first over. Here we Go!

South Africa (PLAYING XI) - Temba Bavuma (C), Janneman Malan, Quinton de Kock, Rassie van der Dussen, Kyle Verreynne (WK), Heinrich Klaasen, Andile Phehlukwayo, Keshav Maharaj, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi, Lizaad Williams.
Ireland (PLAYING XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Simi Singh, Andy McBrine, Mark Adair, Craig Young, Joshua Little.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they will bat first.

After a shock win in the first game, the Irish now have a chance to record their first ever series win over South Africa. A repeat in performance is what they would love but it won’t be easy against the visitors who will surely comeback hard. Remember Irland can’t lose the series even if they do not win this game as the first game was washed out of this three match ODI series. This now becomes a must-win for the away side. Can they bounce back? We will find out. Welcome to the coverage and stay tuned for the toss.
